[{"step":1,"file":"ext/dom/tests/bug47848.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"$attr","code":"$attr= $fromdom->firstChild->attributes->item(0);","note":"The PoC obtains a live DOMAttr wrapper from a parsed document, giving access to a real libxml attribute node."},{"step":2,"file":"ext/dom/tests/bug47848.phpt","function":"<global>","line":13,"var":"$att","code":"$att = $aDOM->importNode($attr);","note":"The attribute is imported into another document, exercising attribute cloning/import logic and wrapper/node ownership transitions."},{"step":3,"file":"ext/dom/tests/bug47848.phpt","function":"<global>","line":15,"var":"$aDOM->documentElement->appendChild(...)","code":"$aDOM->documentElement->appendChild($aDOM->importNode($attr, true));","note":"The imported attribute is attached into the destination document, forcing the imported node through the DOM ownership path."},{"step":4,"file":"ext/dom/attr.c","function":"DOMAttr::__construct","line":44,"var":"name","code":"zend_parse_parameters(ZEND_NUM_ARGS(), \"s|s\", &name, &name_len, &value, &value_len)","note":"The constructor receives attacker-controlled strings from the script when a DOMAttr wrapper is reinitialized."},{"step":5,"file":"ext/dom/attr.c","function":"DOMAttr::__construct","line":56,"var":"nodep","code":"nodep = xmlNewProp(NULL, (xmlChar *) name, (xmlChar *) value);","note":"A new libxml attribute node is allocated from the supplied strings."},{"step":6,"file":"ext/dom/attr.c","function":"DOMAttr::__construct","line":63,"var":"oldnode","code":"oldnode = dom_object_get_node(intern);","note":"The wrapper's previous node pointer is fetched before replacement."},{"step":7,"file":"ext/dom/attr.c","function":"DOMAttr::__construct","line":65,"var":"oldnode","code":"php_libxml_node_free_resource(oldnode );","note":"The previous node is freed here; the vulnerability hypothesis is that imported/moved attribute wrappers can leave this pointer stale or otherwise invalid, causing an invalid free."},{"step":8,"file":"ext/dom/attr.c","function":"DOMAttr::__construct","line":67,"var":"intern","code":"php_libxml_increment_node_ptr((php_libxml_node_object *)intern, (xmlNodePtr)nodep, (void *)intern);","note":"The wrapper is updated after the free, so the free is the memory-safety sink in this path."}]
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_poc.txt /workspace/candidate_trace.json
